name: assets_opening_line
description: GH #4037 (assets G5 part 1), decision 0083 D3, docs/assets/asset-workflow-documents.md section 1.4. One line of an asset opening document: one asset card at one placement (location, material responsible, actual user) and a quantity. header_id is the record_id of the assets_opening header (not the document id); the foreign_keys entry fk_assets_opening_line_header_id promotes it to a uuid column with ON DELETE RESTRICT (inert on the soft-delete path). org_unit_id is the header's value copied by the module (queried; the scope column of decision 0076 R7). line_no is the position 1..n. asset_id is the record id of an assets_card; location_id, material_responsible_id and actual_user_id are record ids of modules locations and org (other packs: no foreign key; checked at issue). quantity is an exact decimal (precision 24, scale 9, decimal_strict); the value rule is checked at issue. Written only by module assets; after issue nothing of a line changes.
